title: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A shapeshifting planeswalker, Oona's first attempt at an heir, who returns to Shadowmoor as a faerie and reveals himself as Maralen's brother.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: The faerie queen, an avatar of Oona, who is stabbed by Rhys with moonglow-coated dagger and left dying.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: The old faerie queen who made Maralen and Oko, whom Rhys believes Maralen to be.

entities.name: Maralen of the Mornsong
entities.description: The elf whose selfish nature Oona used as a mask for her avatar.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: An elven hunter who stabs Maralen with moonglow believing she is Oona, then realizes his mistake.

entities.name: Ashling
entities.description: A flamekin who becomes rimekin at night, keeps her memory across aspects and defends the group in the battle.

entities.name: Tamira
entities.description: A gorgon student shot with an arrow in the battle and left dying until Ajani heals her.

entities.name: Sanar
entities.description: A goblin student who throws rocks at the elves, helps Tam and joins Kirol to find the dawnglove.

entities.name: Kirol
entities.description: A vampire student who returns with Ajani and works out that dawnglove may cure moonglow.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A white-furred leonin planeswalker who carries Kirol into the battle and heals Tam.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker and Strixhaven professor whom Oko has met.

entities.name: Isilu
entities.description: The moon-headed incarnation that protects Maralen's party and bellows warnings at the elves.

entities.name: Brigid Baeli
entities.description: The kithkin warrior in her night form who leads a charge on the elves.

entities.name: Morcant
entities.description: The High Perfect who leads the elves against Isilu with a vial of dawnglow, and is changed to her Shadowmoor self.

entities.name: Lluwen
entities.description: An elf hunter who turns on Morcant, steals her vial and flees with the students.

entities.name: Elves
entities.description: The elf army marching on Isilu with captive sunlight elementals in reliquaries.

entities.name: Kithkin
entities.description: The Shadowmoor kithkin of Goldmeadow who fight as one against the elves.

entities.name: Sunlight elementals
entities.description: Captive elementals held in elf reliquaries to shield the elves from night; they bow to Isilu and flee when freed.

entities.name: Dawnglove
entities.description: A Shadowmoor flower with curative properties and a potion distilled from it, which can counter moonglow.

entities.name: Moonglove
entities.description: A Lorwyn flower and the deadliest known daylight poison distilled from it.

entities.name: Founder Dragons
entities.description: Fabled dragons of Strixhaven to which Kirol compares Isilu.

entities.name: Lorwyn-Shadowmoor
entities.description: The twinned plane where the battle is fought.

entities.name: Goldmeadow
entities.description: The village transformed into Shadowmoor, home of the night-touched kithkin.

entities.name: Abigale
entities.description: An owlin student who fell in the river and is feared lost.

events.summary: Elves advance on Maralen's party as the kithkin form a united wall and Isilu draws near with the faerie.
events.quote: The night-touched kithkin continued to ready their weapons and adjust their positions

events.summary: Maralen greets the faerie as her brother, but it flits back to Isilu.
events.quote: You came home!

events.summary: Isilu lowers its head to Ashling and begins circling the party protectively against the elves.
events.quote: It's protecting us,

events.summary: Maralen explains that her brother was made a shapeshifter and the blue faerie was his Lorwyn self.
events.quote: The blue faerie that accompanied us was his Lorwyn self, and unfamiliar to me.

events.summary: Ashling reveals the elf torches hold captive sunlight elementals.
events.quote: Chained and captive and carried into night.

events.summary: The elves charge and join battle with the kithkin.
events.quote: Then, with a peal of silvered bells, they surged forward and joined the battle.

events.summary: Kithkin arrows knock reliquaries from elves, freeing the sunlight elementals and transforming the elves into their Shadowmoor selves.
events.quote: gasped and changed, flesh and bone melting smoothly into their Shadowmoor selves.

events.summary: Sanar hits an elf archer with a rock and defiantly tells the elves to back off.
events.quote: We just want to go home

events.summary: A disarmed elf becomes a Shadowmoor elf and defects, prompting Brigid and the kithkin to charge.
events.quote: Brigid seemed to take her defection as a cue

events.summary: Tam is shot in the abdomen with an arrow and falls.
events.quote: an arrow protruding from her abdomen.

events.summary: Rhys approaches Maralen with a poisoned dagger, calling her Oona.
events.quote: I made your heir a promise. I made my friend a promise. This ends now.

events.summary: Rhys cuts Maralen's arm; she bleeds petals and collapses, and Rhys is stunned that she did not fight back.
events.quote: the wound bled petals in place of blood

events.summary: The faerie drops to the ground, grows into a tall winged man and confronts Rhys, declaring Oona dead and Maralen his sister.
events.quote: Oona is dead. Maralen was my sister

events.summary: Sanar deduces the man is Maralen's brother, whom Oona made and threw away, while treating Tam's wound.
events.quote: You're Maralen's brother, the one who left before she was Maralen.

events.summary: Oko recounts leaving Oona and mistaking Maralen for Oona reborn, and Rhys learns the poison has sealed her fate.
events.quote: His knife was coated in moonglow.

events.summary: Touched by an elf's sunlit reliquary, Oko turns into his Lorwyn self and transforms the elf into an elk.
events.quote: The elk that stood in his place looked bewildered

events.summary: Oko turns more elves into rabbits to protect Sanar and tells Rhys that raising arms against day is raising them against night.
events.quote: She serves Lorwyn, and I serve Shadowmoor.

events.summary: Ajani leaps over the elf line carrying Kirol and joins the group.
events.quote: The figure became clear as a white-furred leonin, carrying Kirol cradled close against his chest.

events.summary: Oko reveals that Liliana knows him as Oko and that he was Oona's first attempt at an heir.
events.quote: She knows me as Oko. I was Oona's first attempt at an heir.

events.summary: Kirol explains that dawnglove may counter moonglow, and Oko flies off to find Morcant.
events.quote: Don't let my sister die before I return,

events.summary: Ajani heals Tam's wound by removing the arrow with glowing fingers.
events.quote: His fingers glowed white as he eased the arrow out of her flesh, and the injury began to knit up under his touch.

events.summary: Kirol and Sanar slip away to find the dawnglove and find Morcant holding a vial of dawnglow.
events.quote: It was no true surprise when they got there to find Perfect Morcant

events.summary: Lluwen headbutts Morcant, steals her vial and throws it to Sanar.
events.quote: He leaned over to pluck the vial from her hand.

events.summary: Morcant transforms to her Shadowmoor self and bows apologetically to Isilu as the students flee with Lluwen to reach Maralen.
events.quote: We're going to see the queen,

relations.note: Oko was Oona's first attempt at an heir.
relations.quote: I was Oona's first attempt at an heir.

relations.note: Brother and sister, both made by Oona.
relations.quote: I returned for Shadowmoor's sake, and was reminded that I had a sister.

relations.note: Rhys stabs Maralen with a moonglow-coated dagger, which Oko says seals her fate.
relations.quote: She trusted you. She cared for you.

relations.note: Oko vows to kill Rhys if Maralen dies.
relations.quote: If you've killed her before I could know her worth, I'll kill you in kind.

relations.note: Oko rests a hand on Isilu and serves Shadowmoor.
relations.quote: The man tossed the reliquary aside as he reached out to rest a hand against Isilu's flank
This is Ajani. He's a friend of Professor Vess's.

relations.note: Lluwen defects and helps the students, earning a nickname from Kirol.
He headbutts her and steals her vial.
relations.quote: slammed his forehead into hers, hard enough that Kirol and Sanar heard bone crack.

relations.note: The kithkin fight the elf army.
relations.quote: The elves struck as individuals, and the kithkin moved as one.

relations.note: Freed elementals bow to Isilu in deference.
relations.quote: They bowed to Isilu in obvious deference
